senses.gloss: m. pl. h. a. ch. (חָלַט II) final action, decision. לחֲ׳ finally, permanently, absolutely (b. h. לִצְמִיתוּת).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 25:23">Targ. Lev. XXV, 23</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:13">Ex. R. s. 3</cite>; <cite ref="Arakhin 15b:18">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106b:17">Snh. 106ᵇ</cite>.—
Lev. R. s. 7, end, v. יְרִיבָה.—V. חַלְטָנִית.—בח׳ by final decision (from which there is no appeal).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42">Gen. R. s. 42</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 72">Yalk. ib. 72</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:15">Koh. R. to V, 15</cite> <he>היך מה דאתא בחלו׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בחלי׳</he>) as man enters this world by final decision, so does he leave it it (cmp.
